text:
Maria (CS): Quick sync — want to align on "prospect activation pathways" for this Beta cohort. A couple of accounts are stalled at invite/bootstrapping and we risk regression before kickoff. Short thread to assign owners & next steps.

Leo (Product): Good call. Which accounts are we worrying about? I can check feature-flag eligibility and gating constraints.

Maria (CS): Nimbus Inc., FolioHealth, Qubit Labs. Nimbus = security review open, Folio = workspace invite bounced, Qubit = workspace ready but no kickoff scheduled. Tracker: https://docs.internal/reports/beta-cohort (visible to CS/Product/SE).

Ashley (SE): I can take Qubit kickoff — Wed 3:00pm PT works. Can someone point me to a trimmed enablement runbook? Prefer a 20m flow.

Ben (Ops): Folio invite failed due to SSO mismatch (IdP attributes). Re-sent invite after update; asked them to confirm. Flagging Folio as elevated renewal risk if they don't complete onboarding in 2 weeks (~60% risk).

Tara (CS): Recommend micro-survey 24h after invite acceptance — single-question pulse to capture friction. I can schedule SurveyBot to send `tiny-onboard-survey`.

SurveyBot: Scheduled `tiny-onboard-survey` for FolioHealth -> send_at: 1715380000. Link: https://surveys.internal/s/abc123

Maria (CS): Great. Nimbus needs legal/security touch. @Leo (Product) can you loop in Legal? @Sam (AE) can you own procurement so we don't block the security review step? Ben, once security is green, can you provision the private demo env?

Leo (Product): Looping Legal now (cc: @Sam AE). Also adding a `renewal_runway: 90d` note on Nimbus opportunity so AMs see the timeline.

Sam (AE): I’ll own procurement for Nimbus — creating PO checklist and adding `task: procurement-nimbus-3421` in CRM. Will update once the contract path is clear.

Ashley (SE): Qubit kickoff agenda (short): 1) 2m intros 2) 5m install guide (link to gist) 3) 8m first-run checklist + sample prompt set 4) 5m success criteria + next steps. I’ll post slides in #eng-devex.

Maria (CS): Action items recap: Ashley -> run Qubit Wed 3pm PT; Ben -> confirm Folio SSO + monitor tiny-survey; Sam -> procurement for Nimbus; Leo -> legal/security escalation + notify when green. I’ll update cohort tracker after each change and ping AMs for renewal risk. :thumbsup:

Ben (Ops): Updated Folio invite & scheduled follow-up task for 48h. Tiny-survey queued.

Maria (CS): Thanks team — if no blockers we’ll roll the cohort enablement plan Thursday (asynchronous playbook + live office hours). If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here or DM and I’ll reassign.

Ashley (SE): All good from my side. Posting slides now.

Sam (AE): Procurement task created, will report status by EOD tomorrow.

Leo (Product): Legal pinged, awaiting their checklist.

Maria (CS): Awesome. Closing thread — will reopen if any account still stalled by Friday. :calendar:
